storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard; keep away from steam and moisture.
looksLike: A fine, pale beige to light-tan powder with a warm, sharp, slightly lemony smell. It is ground from peeled, sun-dried ginger rhizome.
howToPick: Fine, pale beige powder with a sharp aroma, no lumps or damp patches. A grey tint, musty smell or stickiness suggests old or damp stock.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a sealed pack.
substitutes: Allspice or a pinch of garam masala

usedIn.raw: 1 g dry ginger powder per serving (½ tsp)
0.3 g dry ginger powder per serving, replacing fresh ginger (not in the standard recipe)
